topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: I can't believe it's been days since I heard, and I can't shake it off. I keep thinking about the times we spent together, you know, the laughter, the secrets, the way we promised we'd always be there. And now, it's like none of it ever happened. How can someone just... forget? I replay every call, every text, hoping I misheard, but it's just not possible. It feels like every memory I have, every part of my past, is suddenly up in the air, like it's not real. I know I should move on, but how can I when every piece of me is tied to those moments, to you?
